In this fast paced world, the eCommerce landscape is booming so much, offering opportunities for entrepreneurs and business owners to showcase their products to a global audience. As we know there are so many platforms to gain your attention, but choosing the best one can feel so mind boggling.

Of these so many platforms Magento, WordPress, and BigCommerce, but Shopify is the king of all of them. You don’t need to check other platforms if you are already looking at Shopify. It’s a powerful and user friendly solution for all sizes of the business and makes a great online presence. A good online presence is key to online growth.

This blog post is all about exploring its core functionality and 10 key mobile commerce benefits that make Shopify a perfect platform to build and grow your business empire. If you read this blog you can move to Shopify without any hesitation. So, let’s get into the world of Shopify and get ready to grow your business.
contentAfterToc:
What is Shopify?

Shopify is an extensive eCommerce platform designed to expedite the process of creating and managing your online store. Shopify offers complete solutions and provides everything your business needs from setting up your storefront and managing products to processing and fulfilling payments and orders.

Shopify is your one stop shop for creating and managing your successful business. It offers you lots of good Shopify features like a drag and drop facility and drop shipping, the best thing is you don’t need technical or coding knowledge.

How does Shopify work?

Shopify is running on the subscription model, providing you with a secure and hosted platform to create and manage your online Shopify app store. Unlike the self hosted platforms where you need some technical and coding expertise, Shopify handles the technical things for you and gives a time to focus on your most valuable assets, your products, and your customers.

Here I simplify the process so, you can understand how it works, please see the below points:

  • Choose the best plan: Choose a Shopify subscription plan that suits your business needs.
  • Design your storefront look: Select the Shopify theme or customize one that can suit and match your brand awareness.
  • Add products: Create your products and fill in details like SEO based product descriptions, high quality images, and pricing and tax information.
  • Manage inventory: Track your inventory daily, and set up automatic reordering so you never stockouts.
  • Integrate Shopify payment gateways: Set secured and trusted payment gateways, you can use Shopify payments or any trusted third party providers.

Why Choose Shopify?

The decision to choose Shopify is based on its robust set of features and functionality that empower you to create and manage the most prospering online business store. We are going to discuss the most powerful key mobile commerce benefits of Shopify, which set Shopify apart from others and make it the king of eCommerce platforms.

When this blog post is focused on the Shopify benefits, it is worth showing their mobile optimization capabilities, which is more critical in the mobile driven world. Shopify themes are designed with mobile optimization in mind, ensuring a smooth browsing experience on smartphones and tablets. It ensures that your customer easily navigates your store, and finalizes the purchases, so it increases your leads and ROI.

10 key benefits of choosing Shopify

1. Effortless setup and user friendly interface

Shopify possesses the most user friendly interface that needs little technical knowledge. Its perceptive dashboard guides you through each step of setting up your Shopify app store, from adding products to managing orders.

The best part of Shopify is the drag and drop features, using it you can easily customize your storefront. It doesn’t matter if you are a beginner, you can easily grip it up in a very short time.

2. Extensive App store to enhance functionality

Shopify’s greatest strength is its flourishing Shopify app store. With lots of Shopify apps, you can customize the store look and its functionality as per your specific needs. If you want to add live chat support, put in place loyalty programs, or integrate a social media platform, here at the Shopify app store there is an app for everything.

Conclusion

Shopify gives power to entrepreneurs of all levels to create and manage their powerful businesses. With a huge Shopify app store, user friendly interface, awesome Shopify marketing tools, and a protected platform, Shopify can be your one stop shop. That gives you all you need to thrive in the rapidly changing eCommerce industry.

With those lots of Shopify benefits and its superstar image, there are still some drawbacks, like transaction fees, limited design customization, app dependence on advanced features, not ideal for complex inventory management, and vendor lock in.

There are lots of eCommerce platforms and every platform is best with its features and mobile commerce benefits, but Shopify is always the best of all of them. So when you choose the platform then make sure that you are well researched and have an idea about your business needs, budget, and user experience.
